placeholders.{{presentLiteral}}: string literal known to exist in the eval checkout
placeholders.{{absentLiteral}}: string literal known to be absent, including ignored files
placeholders.{{symbol}}: exact Type.Member defined in the eval checkout
placeholders.{{deployableA}}: first deployable named in ARCHITECTURE.md Deployables with a local checkout
placeholders.{{deployableB}}: second deployable covered by the same graphify-out/ graph
placeholders.{{missingLocalRepo}}: repository with an origin URL but no local checkout
placeholders.{{packageMember}}: member owned by a package restored in the local eval checkout
